title: The conversion presets
description: Each button is one `--preset`. All three are calibrated to the same target — scene mid-grey 0.18 delivered at 0.4525, the brightness approved on 2026-09-15 — so brightness is held constant and what differs is the stock response. chr-generic is the proposed default. All use extended Reinhard at 6 stops. Each button is `hanten convert --preset <name>` and nothing else — the exposure and the density scale come from the preset. The retired sigmoid presets render only from the reference build (scripts/reference-snapshot/).

configs.label: chr generic
configs.note: characteristic curve, no --film-stock: the average of nine published sheets — --preset characteristic-generic

configs.label: chr stock
configs.note: characteristic curve, the roll's own published response — --preset characteristic-stock

configs.label: chr aim
configs.note: characteristic-stock plus the aim-matched red density scale — --preset characteristic-aim
